question: A diagonal of a quadrilateral is 40 cm. The length of the perpendicular from opposite ends is 7.5 cm and 8.6 cm. What is the area of quadrilateral?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The area of a quadrilateral with a known diagonal and two perpendicular offsets is calculated directly as:

Area = 1/2 × Diagonal × (Sum of perpendicular offsets)

Area = 1/2 × 40 × (7.5 + 8.6)

Area = 20 × 16.1 = 322

**∴ The correct answer is 322 cm².**
